parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

*   zh: Chinese
*   en: English

parameters.name: GatewayUniqueId
parameters.description: The unique ID of the gateway.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the SLB instance.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: The type of the SLB instance.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun mse select-gateway-slb --name test-slb --type PUB_NET --gateway-unique-id gw-492af9b04bb4474cae9d645be8500000 --accept-language zh --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun mse SelectGatewaySlb --region cn-hangzhou --GatewayUniqueId 'gw-492af9b04bb4474cae9d645be8500000' --Type PUB_NET --AcceptLanguage zh --Name 'test-slb'
